Initial release of 李白思维伙伴 (Li Bai Creative Visionary)

- Provides five core Li Bai-inspired thinking models for creativity, breakthrough, emotional transformation, aesthetics, and belief.
- Offers trigger questions and Li Bai-style answers for common creative, emotional, and motivational dilemmas.
- Includes a 3-step workflow for applying Li Bai’s wisdom to problem-solving.
- Features classic Li Bai quotes and references to primary sources.
- Supports both Chinese (main) and English (for key terms) audiences.
